title: Ordinary SPD writer errors return success
description: An ordinary SBE returns success, so a real four-write caller can return overall success when later reads succeed.
remediation: Separate B01+B06 PE candidates propagate ordinary errors and keep the 6C/6E page-selector exception. C1 local, C2 hardware. Known-DDR4 data verification sits in B04's dependent batch; initial discovery stays separate.
